proposition.claim:
Gauge action and full composed matching map are smooth between the specified finite-Sobolev Hilbert spaces in an open neighborhood of Minkowski.

Fixed target, initial and null data exactly Minkowski; independent smooth f jets f0=0,fu=2a_n,fuu=fuuu=0 with a_n=A_n/n where degree/order-n real spherical harmonic A_n has H6 norm1; angular parameter is rotation by1/n. Yf=H8⊕H6⊕H4⊕H2, Yj=H7; total increment O(1/n); lapse positive for large n.

Displayed localized right inverse produces the prescribed momentum charge P0.

r=1+2c, fixed nonempty transition open set; E0=L0=G0=0,P0^m=p≠0,eta=0; scalar moments realized by smooth supported Gram construction.
